sql: WITH RECURSIVE modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_zero_month'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='purchase_negative' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode<>'dw_only' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), spine AS (SELECT mo.mode,c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net,n.m IS NOT NULL active FROM modes mo CROSS JOIN customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON mo.mode=n.mode AND c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing,MAX(CASE WHEN active THEN m END) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id) last_m FROM spine), lagged AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_close,LAG(net,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_net FROM balance), phases AS (SELECT 'latest_customer' phase,* FROM lagged WHERE m=last_m UNION ALL SELECT 'global_april',* FROM lagged WHERE m=(SELECT MAX(m) FROM months)), metric AS (SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'cumulative' kind,closing current,prior_close prev FROM phases UNION ALL SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'monthly',net,prior_net FROM phases) SELECT phase,mode,kind,COUNT(*) n,SUM(prev=0) zero_prior,SUM(prev<0) neg_prior,SUM(prev>0 AND (current-prev)*100.0/prev>5) positive_prior_pass,SUM(prev=0 AND current>0) zero_pass,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/current END>5)/COUNT(*) current_denom_pct,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (MAX(current,0)-MAX(prev,0))*100.0/NULLIF(MAX(prev,0),0) END>5)/COUNT(*) clipped_pct FROM metric GROUP BY phase,mode,kind
